page.overview:
Who is Gol?

Gol, known as the "Wither King," was a male Force-sensitive individual who became a Sith. only the hands of the Sith displayed his true condition.

As an infant, Gol was orphaned when his guardian was gunned down. He grew up alone and was shunned and bullied throughout his childhood. Eventually, he turned to the dark side of the Force, bleeding a kyber crystal and using it to fashion his Sith lightsaber.

As a Sith Lord, Gol was able to amass a court of lesser Sith. He ruled from a castle on an unknown world.

Gol was known to take prisoners, and his castle contained a vast dungeon where his prisoners were imprisoned and tortured. One such prisoner, a Jedi, was forced to wear jester clothing and serve as his "Jester Jedi." Eventually, the Jester Jedi could no longer bear his treatment and threw himself off the castle roof to his death, which Gol considered "the only funny thing he ever did."
